description: Shared-account ten-second aggressive-flow breakout acceptance at completed 4-hour/day/week external liquidity

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill is charged the same conservative 6 bp used by the diagnostic. Market entry, stop and target remain subject to Nautilus one-tick adverse slippage and bar ordering.

validation_protocol.signal_contract: Completed external level; high aggressive-flow close beyond; contracted ten-second retest holds; separate same-direction aggressive-flow reacceleration.
validation_protocol.global_selection: At any timestamp only the highest causal cost-after net reward-risk signal is eligible; while any order or position exists all other assets are unavailable.
validation_protocol.entry: Market OUO bracket submitted after the completed ten-second confirmation bar.
validation_protocol.sizing: Current full shared USDT NAV times 3 percent divided by expected entry-to-stop loss including two fill fees and two adverse ticks.
validation_protocol.target: Nearest active completed 4-hour/day/week external level; no fitted R fallback.
validation_protocol.promotion: First Nautilus week must pass before the other two fixed weeks. All three must then meet the screen gate before any long evaluation.
